## Implementation spec (Material 3 + Jetpack Compose guidelines)

- **Navigation entry:** add a `composable("VampireDrainPage")` destination to the `NavHost` and (if routed) map `/charging/vampire-drain` to it as a deep link.
- **Screen scaffold:** a stateless `@Composable VampireDrainPageScreen(...)` + a `VampireDrainPageViewModel` (Hilt) that consumes the KMP core repositories/use-cases (ADR-004); hoist UI state into a `StateFlow<UiState>`; expose `load()` / `refresh()`. No business logic in composables.
- **Panels:** lay out every panel above with Compose using the **design tokens** (`MaterialTheme` from A2) — no hardcoded colors/typography (ADR-005).
- **Live data:** if any data source is live, collect the SSE flow (P1/S4) with `collectAsStateWithLifecycle` and surface a `>2 min` staleness indicator (ADR-013).
- **3 data states:** implement `loading` / `empty` / `error` for **each** source listed above.
- **i18n:** every string via `stringResource(...)` (ADR-014); keep web key names.
- **a11y:** `Modifier.semantics` content descriptions on panels + charts, TalkBack, ≥ 48dp targets, dynamic color + dark theme (ADR-015).
- **Units:** format at the display boundary with the shared **SI converters** (P1/S5) — never store/compute non-SI.
